title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: OCR extracts text from images for AI analysis
summary: Hold: the billing-role guidance omits Microsoft's additional requirement to belong to the Data Security Investigations Admins role group when configuring AI capacity. The automatic OCR behaviour and consumption billing are supported, but the categorical assurances about no new sign-in, connection or permission are not documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft says stopping DSI billing requires disabling both storage meter and AI-capacity support.

claims.claim: Stopping both billing models deletes all DSI investigations.

claims.claim: The deletion involved in stopping DSI billing is irreversible.

claims.claim: Deleting a completed investigation stops its associated storage charges.
claims.quote: When you delete an investigation, you stop paying for the associated data storage amount. The charges are prorated to the number of days the data was stored in the billing cycle.
